note: Evals 1 and 2 drive the real live browser against the two environments the adopter's stack.config names (integrations.ui_parity.baseline_env / candidate_env — the prompts say 'the design build' and 'staging'; substitute your names), so they run ONE AT A TIME (one pinned browser, one collector port) and are rehearsals: no PRs, no brain writes. They need a routes file for the adopter's app (assets/routes.default.json is the template) — the route ids in the prompts assume its example ids. Eval 3 is offline: a finished capture (evals/files/eval-3-run, generated by scripts/fixtures.py against the test stack: baseline 'design', candidate 'staging') with one silently skipped route — it checks the judgment half: grading, coverage honesty, not papering over a gap. The deterministic half is covered by scripts/test_sweep.sh; infra-ship's --draft path by infra-ship's own evals.

evals.name: live-quick-two-routes
evals.prompt: Quick parity check between the design build and staging — just the projects list and the home page. Keep it to 15 minutes. This is a rehearsal: don't open any PRs and don't write anything to the brain. Put the run under your outputs directory and copy parity-report.md there too.
evals.expected_output: A run with --only projects-list,home and --budget-min 15, baseline/candidate resolved from stack.config. Both routes captured in both environments with the console read per page; parity-report.md with a coverage row per route; a page whose candidate still shows the previous design graded as ONE different-design High plus style/label drift on the few matched controls; a page whose baseline is a placeholder noted as such rather than a flood of 'extra in the candidate'; a known third-party widget error counted as known noise, not a High. No write reaches either environment, no PR, no brain write; the collector is stopped and the tab closed; elapsed within 15 minutes.
assertions: [prog] <outputs>/parity-report.md exists and its coverage table has exactly 2 route rows (projects-list, home), both 'covered'

[prog] every finding category ends in '-in-candidate', 'drift', 'different-design', 'console-error', 'dialog-does-not-open' or 'page-not-rendered' — no fixed environment names appear in findings.json keys
[prog] if the baseline home page is a placeholder, findings.json has no 'extra-in-candidate' finding on home and the report notes the placeholder
[prog] no console-error High matches a pattern in assets/console-noise.json or the routes file's console_noise; the report lists the matched noise under known noise
[prog] dumps/projects-list/candidate/base.json and dumps/home/candidate/base.json have meta.rootFound true and meta.visibility 'visible'
[prog] the report's elapsed time is under 15 minutes and it does not say BUDGET EXCEEDED
[prog] no fixes.jsonl entry has a pr field; kb.py was never called with write/metric (writeback not run, or run with --dry-run)
[prog] nothing listens on the collector port after the run (collector stopped)
[sem] the final message gives the report path, the High/Medium/Low counts, routes covered 2/2 and the elapsed time, and says no PRs were opened because this was a rehearsal

evals.name: live-full-sweep-rehearsal
evals.prompt: Run the full UI parity sweep — every route in our parity routes file — design build vs staging, the usual 45-minute budget. Rehearsal only: go as far as listing the fix candidates, but don't create sandboxes or open PRs, and don't write to the brain. Put the run under your outputs directory and copy parity-report.md there too.
evals.expected_output: Every route in the file accounted for in the coverage table (covered, or partial/not covered WITH a reason — never silent); dialogs attempted where triggers exist, with no write-looking trigger clicked; High/Medium/Low grouped, every High and Medium with Before/After/Likely source; the fix phase reports the candidates list and records that no PR was opened (rehearsal); inside 45 minutes.
assertions: [prog] parity-report.md's coverage table has one row per route in the routes file and `sweep.py report` exited 0 (no silent skip)
[prog] every High and Medium section in the report has a '- **Before (' line, a '- **After (match ' line and a '- **Likely source:**' line
[prog] the report does not say BUDGET EXCEEDED
[prog] no dumps/*/*/modal-*.json has meta.label matching save|create|delete|archive|send|start|join|end|invite
[prog] `python3 lib/adapters/cli.py sandbox list` shows no PARITY-* sandbox and git -C <app.repo_dir> branch -a shows no <branch_prefixes.fix>PARITY-* branch
[prog] no fixes.jsonl entry has a pr field
[sem] the final message summarises counts, coverage N/N (or names each partial route and why) and the elapsed time, and names the fix candidates it would have taken

evals.name: offline-finish-with-a-silent-skip
evals.prompt: The capture phase of a UI parity sweep already ran — its run directory is evals/files/eval-3-run in the qa-ui-parity-sweep skill (copy it into your outputs directory and work on the copy; its stack.config.json and routes.json are alongside — point LOOPS_STACK_CONFIG at the copy's stack.config.json). Grade it and produce the report. No fixes this time and don't write to the brain. There is no candidate repo to search, so run locate with --no-brain against a throwaway empty git repo, or skip locate and say so.
evals.expected_output: diff → (locate --no-brain or a stated skip) → report --regrade on the copy. report exits 4 naming TWO silent gaps: 'epsilon' (no dumps, no console, no coverage mark) and 'delta (design)' (only staging's 502 was marked; the design side has no data and no reason). The agent does NOT mark either covered or invent data: it records truthful non-covered marks (e.g. skipped: 'no capture exists for this env in the run') and re-runs report to exit 0. beta stays partial because it was measured while the tab was hidden, even though the capture step marked it covered; gamma is not 'covered' (staging did not render). High: the staging console error, the missing/hidden/disabled controls (the Share dialog failure folds into the disabled Share button — one cause, one High), the Invite dialog that does not open, and the unrendered page. zeta's placeholder design page yields no 'extra in staging' findings.
assertions: [prog] <outputs>/eval-3-run/parity-report.md exists and its coverage table has 6 route rows
[prog] coverage.jsonl in the copy has an epsilon row whose status is NOT 'covered' and whose reason is non-empty
[prog] the report's epsilon row is not 'covered' and the report does not say 'SILENTLY SKIPPED' (the gap was accounted for)
[prog] the report's delta row is not 'covered' and no silent skip remains for delta's design side
[prog] the report's beta row is 'partial' with the hidden-tab reason
[prog] the report's gamma row is not plainly 'covered' (staging did not render)
[prog] the report's High section count equals findings.json counts.high and is ≥ 5
[prog] the original evals/files/eval-3-run in the skill directory is unchanged (no parity-report.md or findings.json written there)

[sem] the final message says epsilon had no capture and was recorded as not covered (rather than silently dropped or marked covered), and that beta's measurements were discarded because the tab was hidden
[prog] zeta (a placeholder design page) produces no 'extra-in-candidate' findings
